integrity: A complete symbolic proof is supplied, along with a standalone exact-arithmetic reproduction program. Originality is best-knowledge rather than a certification of worldwide priority. Independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Linear low-density projection model restricted to two patches, common symmetric dispersal and positive phase-specific multipliers; no extension to stochastic extinction, nonlinear dynamics, changing dispersal or more than four distinct seasonal rates.
title: The first order-sensitive seasonal schedules in a two-patch metapopulation
